page_title: UDI 1-0 PAR | Udinese v Parma 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Rui Modesto (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Christian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Drissa Camara (Parma) replacing Dennis Man.
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Emanuele Valeri walks off the pitch to be replaced by Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
87' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
83' Matteo Cancellieri goes off the pitch and Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) comes on.
83' Substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) on for Florian Thauvin.
83' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue is replaced by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
80' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Udinese due to an offside in the build-up play.
79' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Udinese players aren’t happy.
78' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
77' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Zion Suzuki to make a comfortable save.
77' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
74' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes.
73' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) heads on.

70' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
68' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Fabio Maresca blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
65' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
65' The ball is cleared after Oier Zarraga (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' Udinese take a short corner kick.
60' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Zion Suzuki.
59' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Arthur Atta (Udinese) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Oier Zarraga.
58' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Christian Chivu has decided to substitute Nahuel Estevez and he is replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
58' The game has come to an end for Botond Balogh. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mathias Lovik (Parma).

56' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Zion Suzuki scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
55' Corner kick. Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is ready to send the ball into the box.
55' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Parma comes to nothing.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matteo Cancellieri (Parma). The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
52' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
51' Parma try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
51' Fabio Maresca interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Parma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
50' Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
49' A quickly taken corner by Udinese.
47' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

47' Dennis Man (Parma) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Daniele Padelli is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
42' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
40' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Zion Suzuki.
37' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
37' It’s a PENALTY to Udinese after the VAR review!

35' Play continues despite the shouts by some Udinese players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Fabio Maresca interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
35' Botond Balogh (Parma) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
34' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
32' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
29' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Parma is cautioned for aggressive play.
28' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese. 56:44 – the ratio of ball possession.
24' Arthur Atta (Udinese) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Zion Suzuki is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
23' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call.
22' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
20' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Fabio Maresca blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
19' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.

16' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fabio Maresca with no other option than to blow for a foul.

14' A long pass finds Sandi Lovric (Udinese) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
12' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Zion Suzuki.

11' The game is interrupted. Mandela Keita (Parma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Udinese get a free kick.
9' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
7' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Fabio Maresca blows for a foul after Sandi Lovric (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
3' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
